changes: Alt+Tab switches windows however quickly you tap it. A quick tap no longer leaves the overview open.
Super with another key no longer brings up the dock as well (Super+Enter, Super+Q and the rest), and Super+Tab opens the overview again. Made by alex.
Files: right-click menus open whole inside the window, also near its bottom edge, and the buttons on the phone page answer a click. Made by alex.
Hiding a window in the dock: the dock no longer stays up when the app quits on the way, and the app's button lights up for every app, Thyris included. Made by alex.
The small map of the screen (right-click the line at the top of a window) shows a live wallpaper instead of a black card. Made by alex.

kitty and zsh get Tacit's settings, as the built-in terminal and fish have them: the font, the padding, the wallpaper's colours and the see-through look in kitty, the prompt and shortcuts in zsh. Made by ygnk.
Setup says why it can't make room next to Windows: a disk check Windows has waiting, or what the disk itself said, rather than always that Windows didn't shut down fully.
Tacit moves to the newest version of the window system it runs on (Hyprland 0.57). A computer whose updates stopped with a message about Hyprland updates again.

Files can start an app from its launcher (a .desktop file): Start is at the top of its menu. Double-clicked, a launcher marked as a program starts its app; any other opens as text, so one that came from a download never runs by a double-click.
Settings › Desktop › Desktop widgets: choose for each widget whether you drag it where you like or it finds a calm or busy spot on the wallpaper. Made by ygnk.
Three fingers on the touchpad do what the line at the top of a window does: swipe up to close the window under the pointer, down to hide it, left or right to put it on that half of the screen.
The first click on an app in the dock opens it, also right after you sign in.
Apps started from Tacit no longer quit on their own after a while (Discord did).
Files: Put back brings files out of the trash again, and Set up your phone works from start to finish.
Thyris: Add to Chrome in the Chrome Web Store no longer closes Thyris. It asks to add the extension to Thyris, as the line under the address does.
When an install needs your password, the ask says in words what it will do, not the command it runs.
The control panel: rearrange it with Edit under its buttons (Done when you are finished).
Apps: an app you got from the search results says Open there, not Get.
Settings › About: Checked at shows when the last check for updates was.
The corner that opens the notifications is only the top edge of the screen now, so it no longer covers the top of a window in that corner.
Choosing part of the screen for a screenshot offers the pictures on it again.

Close, hide and arrange windows from the small line at the top of every window: carry it up to the notch to close the window, down to the dock to hide it, or to a side of the screen for that half. Double-click it to fill the screen, or right-click it for a small map of the screen with the same places. Click the app in the dock to bring hidden windows back. Apps no longer show close and minimise buttons of their own.
A new Files, made in Tacit's own design: List, Grid, Gallery and Columns views, filters, and a panel for what you select.
Icons on the desktop: the files in your Desktop folder show as light tags you can place anywhere. Drop files on the desktop to put them there.
Alt+Tab switches windows: the overview opens from the notch, Tab moves through your windows, and letting go switches.
Your own shortcuts: Settings › Keyboard & touchpad › Shortcuts changes any shortcut and adds your own for apps.
Send files to your phone from Files: set up your phone once under Devices, then right-click a file and choose Send to your phone.
A new control panel, made by ygnk: the main switches in front, the rest behind More, and the week at a glance.

Thyris adds extensions from the Chrome Web Store: on an extension's page, press Add to Thyris and see what it can do before it is added. Thyris can also show your tabs along the top (right-click the tabs to switch), and scrolls smoothly with a mouse wheel.
The notch no longer covers a video in full screen.
Super+Esc opens the session menu: lock, log out, restart, shut down. Settings is Super+I.
The emoji picker types the emoji into the app you were writing in.
Drag a photo in the wallpaper strip to choose which part of it shows.
Live wallpapers work on every computer.
Installing Tacit next to Windows keeps the clock right in both.
Signing in a new Claude account finishes as soon as you are done in the browser, and Settings shows the account you switched to.
Other programs can no longer start or steer your agent: a hand-off puts your text in the box and you press Enter.
When Files, Activity or Apps can't do something, they say why, with a way to try again.
When your settings file has a mistake in it, Tacit says so once and offers to put back the last good copy; until then, Settings says changes aren't saved.
Many smaller fixes in Settings, Praxis, the Viewer, Activity, Apps, Graphis, the dock, notifications, screenshots, updates and Thyris.

Activity shows the apps still running after you close their window, under In the background. Quit ends one; an app with a tray icon, like Discord or Steam, also has Open. Activity opens again: since 1.1.2 it did not start.
Apps like Discord and Steam keep their tray icon, so they can run in the background as they do elsewhere.
Thyris opens even when an earlier Thyris has stopped answering: the stuck one is closed and a new one starts with your pages.
A page that stops answering in Thyris says so, with Wait and Reload, and the rest of Thyris keeps working.
When an app stops answering, Close it in the notch closes it for sure, and the notch clears once the app is gone.
Thyris: Settings, Find on this page and Reader view show their symbols instead of words.
Thyris fills its window on a screen set to 125 %, 150 % or 200 %. On those screens a page was drawn in the top left of the window, with a dark band beside and below it.
Praxis shows commands and what they printed as written. A command with HTML in it was drawn as formatted text and spilled over the steps around it.
Restart for an update no longer restarts the computer when the update couldn't finish downloading. The notch and Settings say so, and nothing is changed.
Setup on the stick no longer waits forever for a Wi-Fi network that doesn't answer.
Setup on the stick has Try Tacit first: it closes Setup so you can try Tacit without installing it. Install Tacit in the launcher opens Setup again.
Apps shows how many updates an app that needs them first brings with it. It said 0.
A file dropped on the notch shows at the front of the shelf. Once the shelf held more than four, a new file only changed the count.
When something fails, Tacit says what happened in plain words: Wi-Fi that can't join, Praxis when its background service is away, and the desktop or Dictation when it stops.
Settings > Updates keeps the time of the last check up to date while the page is open.
Logging out brings back the sign-in screen. It left a black screen until the computer was restarted.
A window you share in a call or in Discord keeps moving when you switch to another workspace or app, instead of freezing on its last frame.

Settings > Display & power has a power mode for the charger and one for the battery, as on Windows: Fastest, Balanced or Saves battery. The Power mode button in the control panel changes the one in use.
Windows, the notch and the terminal stay as easy to read on light wallpapers as on dusk: the glass darkens to suit the wallpaper.
A video or picture on its own in the viewer no longer shows a frame of the desktop around it.
Thyris: Ctrl and the scroll wheel, or a pinch on the touchpad, zoom the page.
Thyris: when a pinned site has moved off the page you pinned, that page shows under Pinned, and the home button there takes it back.
VS Code, LibreOffice and other apps from Apps can open your files and USB drives, and an app that needs an update before it installs says so instead of failing.
Emoji show in the emoji picker (Super+.) and the launcher on new accounts.
Files shows thumbnails of new pictures and of videos.
The music icon in the notch brings Thyris forward when Thyris is playing.
Settings shows previews of wallpapers whose names have #, ? or % in them, and saves a new wallpaper at once, so a restart right after keeps it.
A picture opened from Files comes up in front of it, in the middle of the screen.
The sunset plays when you shut down or restart. Shutting down no longer waits five seconds, and no text flashes on the screen at the end.
The touchpad has its own speed in Settings > Keyboard & touchpad, apart from the mouse, and speeds are shown in words.
Tacit's own wallpapers, the 14 Horizons, are in Pictures > Wallpapers and in Settings > Wallpaper, on accounts that had no Wallpapers folder yet.
Games and other older apps show Tacit's pointer instead of a plain grey arrow.
Bluetooth has the security fixes made since its last release, among them two that someone nearby could use.
Passphrases for SSH keys and signing ask in the notch again instead of failing at once.

Screen recording lives in the notch: press Super+Shift+R, or find Screen recording in the palette, and record the whole screen, an area or a window, with or without sound. The notch shows the time while it records, and a click stops it.
Praxis works with the new opencode: it runs opencode sessions again, and signs in to OpenCode Zen and other providers.
Copy, cut and paste in Files always paste what you copied last, from any window or app.
Thyris: a sideways swipe in Google Sheets and other pages that scroll sideways on their own no longer goes back a page.
The notch makes room for a 12-hour clock, so AM and PM no longer run into what is shown beside it.
Updates come from Tacit's tested copy of Arch: Restart, or pacman in a terminal, installs only what Tacit has tested.
Open dialogs in other apps (browsers, Electron and GTK apps) work, and so does Show in folder.
Sign-ins open in the notch, from Praxis (Claude, Codex, ChatGPT) and from other apps.
Thyris: Make default works, a second sign-in no longer closes it, and a two-finger swipe goes back and forward.
The wallpaper is sharp unless you blur it with the new switch in Settings > Wallpaper, and Settings remembers the folder you picked it from.
On a new account, colours follow a new accent at once, and a lock screen picture no longer recolours the desktop.
Clicking a notification brings its app forward, and a chat message the same as the one before still shows.
The see-through choice in Settings > Appearance changes the apps' windows.
Restart installs the update even when it was pressed while the update was still downloading.
Media keys work, and Graphis opens the file you asked for.
fastfetch and other system tools call the system Tacit instead of Arch Linux.
On computers with NVIDIA graphics, Tacit turns on NVIDIA's own sleep and wake services.
Copy and paste works between Thyris and every other app, both ways, pictures included.
Pages in Thyris can take files again, and sign-ins open in the notch.
Pages in Thyris no longer stay stretched after a window opens beside them or Thyris is resized.
Night light, screen recording, a desktop monitor's brightness and USB drives in Files work on every computer.
The keyboard and touchpad no longer stop answering, and the brightness keys change the screen again.
The emoji picker shows its emoji, in colour.
Thyris blocks ads with uBlock Origin Lite on every computer.
Updates show how far they are, and what changed in them.
Setup puts Tacit in the computer's start-up menu when it installs next to Windows.
